meta.strategy: canonical server V4 + pre-registered holding stop overlays

pre_registered_variants.fixed_shock_rank2: shock <= -5%/ -10%, then V3-G filtered momentum rank #2
pre_registered_variants.v3g_confirmed_shock: shock plus held V3-G 5d momentum <=0 and slow momentum <=0; rank #2 must have positive slow momentum and trend
pre_registered_variants.v4_first_confirmation_shock: shock plus the first V4 fast/slow consensus target, before the normal 2/2 confirmation
pre_registered_variants.fixed_shock_cash: fixed shock exits to cash and suppresses re-entry until the next fixed grid
pre_registered_variants.v4_first_confirmation_cash: shock plus first V4 consensus signal exits to cash; re-entry waits for the next fixed grid

meta.no_lookahead: stop uses only current holding closes through T; forward relative returns are reporting only

params.execution: T-day close approximation, same as canonical V4 research
